testcase.name: Scenario: Save a new part while closing its tab: tmp/obk-quick-access-3955-source/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:133:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Save a new part while closing its tab ✔ Given a new part with an unsaved sketch is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And another part was active before the new part was created ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ And the suggested file name does not exist in the selected folder ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the new part's document tab ✔ And the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt ✔ And the user accepts the suggested file name in the Save As dialog ✔ Then the part file exists at the selected location ✔ And the new part's tab disappears ✔ And the previously active part is displayed ✔ When the user reopens the saved part file ✔ Then the reopened part is active ✔ And its sketch is listed in the model browser
